name: KakaoTalk on Wayland
description: Makes KakaoTalk usable under Wine's Wayland driver, which leaves it several things short. Puts the new-message popup where the app asks for it, since a Wayland client cannot place its own windows. Stops that popup taking the keyboard, which in the middle of typing sends the keystrokes to a chat room. Stands in for the tray, which Wayland has no protocol for: a panel indicator brings the window back and opens the app's own menu. And offers to install the app, since a shell extension lives where a sandboxed app cannot put itself.
